note: Pip mini-rig (request 087, D-055/D-056, look = chr_pip_a_concept). Format as usach_*_parts.json: pixel coords in each part PNG (origin top-left); 'joint' = point of the part that sits on its parent; 'attach' = where that joint lands, in the parent's PNG pixels. Facing right (e); facing left = mirror. Scale = chr_pip_a_concept source (170 px tall with eye stalks, ART_SCALE 0.5 in game, D-045: hero 208 px source). 'rest_deg' = rest rotation about the joint (clockwise, degrees); 'tint' = suggested multiplier for the far stalk (engine). Eye stalks are drawn behind the body: ~7 px below the joint is joint reserve hidden inside the head; the engine swings them with a spring. 'letter' is a separate prop held at the mouth; detach it to hand it to the hero. Body has no shell; the shell sits on the hump.

body.note: root: middle of the foot sole under the shell; neck rises at x>=135, head top ~(158,5), mouth ~(168,37)

shell.note: bottom of the shell whorl; covers the body hump, right edge stops at the neck (~x 137 on the body); satchel is painted on the shell

eyestalk_near.note: front stalk; joint 8 px above the rounded base (reserve under the head); eye at the top (12,10)

eyestalk_far.note: back stalk; same drawing as near (like the hero legs), darkened by tint in engine

cap.note: underside centre of the crown on the head top, between the stalk bases; peak to the right

letter.note: left corner of the envelope held in the mouth; separate so the engine can hand it to the hero
